status_taxonomy.description: The lane proof is current for the requested release tag and commit.
The lane produced a policy-allowed warning and does not block publish unless its lane policy says otherwise.
The lane ran and produced a failing proof or verifier result.
The lane proof does not match the requested release tag, commit, workflow run, or required digest.
The lane proof artifact is absent from the release-readiness input set.
The public-access lane used credentials or private checkout state where unauthenticated public fetches are required.
The proof ran on a fixture or host class that cannot satisfy the configured lane substrate.

readiness_stages.policy_text: Release upload may acquire publish authority only after build, workflow-policy, docs-command, and hostless installer proofs pass for the exact tag, commit, and workflow run.
Latest promotion additionally requires the privileged real-KVM quickstart proof. The hostless fixture never substitutes for this lane.
The public latest lane runs after latest moves and proves unauthenticated users can fetch the promoted installer and proof assets.

lanes.title: Workflow authority policy and syntax gates
lanes.policy_text: Release workflows must keep write authority isolated to the publish job before any upload or latest-promotion step.

lanes.title: Release bundle, checksum, and attestation integrity
lanes.policy_text: Public bundles are publishable only when the signed predicate binds the release tag, commit, asset index, installer, checksums, and attestation metadata.

lanes.title: Public quickstart docs command freshness
lanes.policy_text: Public release docs are publishable only when README and runbook quickstart snippets match the shared command contract and rendered install URLs.

lanes.title: Hostless release fixture quickstart proof
lanes.policy_text: The hostless fixture proves the installer handoff shape and artifact references before upload, but it never substitutes for the real-KVM lane.

lanes.title: Privileged real-KVM quickstart smoke
lanes.policy_text: A public release is not fully promoted until the documented quickstart command has run on a privileged host with /dev/kvm.

lanes.title: Unauthenticated public latest access proof
lanes.policy_text: Docs cannot treat latest as promoted until unauthenticated GitHub release URLs fetch the public installer and proof assets.

lanes.title: Scheduled latest/docs freshness check
lanes.policy_text: Freshness drift files a repair bead and blocks the next release once promoted to a failing required lane.
